chunks: Al-Fadl, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from 'Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Stay close to the ground and do not move your hands or feet until you witness the signs that I mention to you, and I do not think you will live to see them: The disintegration of the descendants of so-and-so, a caller calling out from the sky, and the voice coming to you from the direction of Damascus with victory, and the subsiding of a village from the villages of al-Sham called al-Jabiya. And the brothers of the Turks will advance until they settle in al-Jazira, and the mariqah (rebels) of the Romans will advance until they settle in Ramla. That year will have much disagreement in every land from the direction of the Maghrib (the West). The first land to be ruined is al-Sham; they will dispute there over three standards: the standard of the Red, the standard of the Spotted, and the standard of the Sufyani.

key_terms.الْأَبْقَع: The Spotted (one of the three standards)
key_terms.الْأَصْهَب: The Red (one of the three standards)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific signs of the end times mentioned in the hadith of Jabir al-Ju'fi?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) outlines the 'Lesser Occultation' signs, emphasizing the Sufyani's emergence in al-Sham as a precursor to the major uprising. The mention of the 'voice from Damascus' and the 'marking' of the earth reflects classical Shia exegetical interpretations of geopolitical turmoil preceding the Mahdi's appearance. These events serve as critical markers for distinguishing the true Imam from false claimants during the period of widespread confusion.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 434 - It is narrated from Al-Fadl from Hasan bin Mahbub from 'Amru bin Abil Miqdam from Jabir Al-Ju'fi from Abu Ja'far (a.s) that he said:

“Stay close to the ground and do not move your hands or feet until you witness the signs that I mention to you, and I don’t think that you will live until that time: The descendats of so-and-so will disintegrate into groups, a caller will call out from the sky and his voice will come to you from the direction of Damascus with victory, one of your villages in the region of al-Sham (greater Syria) named Jabia would cave into the ground, the brothers of the Turks will rise up in Jazira, and the remnants of the Romans will attack Ramla. In that year, there will be much disagreement in every land, from the direction of the Maghrib (the West). The first land to be ruined will be al-Sham. The cause of its destruction will be the meeting of three standards there; the standard of the Red, the standard of the Spotted and the standard of the Sufyani.”
